events.text:
T-151 is in review: the intake service works and the PR is open, but the triage agent scored 83% on the 30 real reports, short of the 90% target.

- **Intake:** widget, form and team-channel reports land in one queue. All six required fields are enforced, and the 4 local tests pass. Acknowledgement and shipped emails go only to [email]. The how-to-report guide is written.
- **Triage:** 25 of 30 reports were fully correct. Type was right on 28 of 30. Severity was within one level on 29 of 30 but exactly right on only 18. I had already tuned the prompt against this batch, so 83% is generous. The remaining misses come from a few duplicate calls and some reports where the truth label is arguable, so a better-labelled batch is the next step.
- **PR:** the PR to `development` is [Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2#166](https://github.[redacted]). It adds only the widget, the guide and a README under `docs/feedback-intake/`, with no product code. I could not confirm Bharath was added as a reviewer, because the reviewer list on the PR came back empty. Someone may need to request his review by hand. Nothing is merged.

The intake code is in `workshop-plan/feedback-intake` and committed. I set reviewers on the task to Amal and Bharath and acknowledged F-65aa7c02.
